disclosure.title: Before you play
disclosure.unsanitized_html: This game's displays can contain HTML that is not sanitized. The server's admin vouches for the games installed here, but nothing checks what that HTML does.
disclosure.seat_inheritance: Whoever takes your seat next receives everything attached to it: its hand, sheet, journal, marks and plan.
disclosure.public_ratings_stats: Ratings and recorded stats are always visible to everyone and cannot be hidden.
disclosure.admin_media: The admin can see who uploaded any file, and can delete any file.
core.match.ready: The match is ready to end.

core.disclosure.release_table: What was said privately between matches can now be seen in replays.

core.pending.commit: Seat {seat} lays down a play of {count}.
core.notice.tell_admin: Your client keeps sending actions the rules refuse. It has resynced; if this continues, please tell the admin.
core.vote.failed_no_quorum: Vote failed for lack of a quorum: {question}
core.vote.notation_load: Load this {notation} text into the match?
